description: This file handles the 'Add' request message in a USP (User Service Platform) protocol. It includes functions for processing addition requests, creating objects, handling transaction control, and generating responses. The core functions include handling the Add message, resolving object paths, and constructing appropriate success or error responses.

methods.name: void MSG_HANDLER_HandleAdd(Usp__Msg * usp,char * controller_endpoint,mtp_conn_t * mtpc)
methods.description: Main handler for processing incoming Add messages; validates message and delegates processing based on 'allow_partial' flag.

methods.name: Usp__Msg * ProcessAdd_AllowPartialTrue(char * msg_id,Usp__Msg * usp,combined_role_t * combined_role)
methods.description: Processes an Add request with 'allow_partial' set to true, attempting to add each object and continuing despite individual failures.

methods.name: Usp__Msg * ProcessAdd_AllowPartialFalse(char * msg_id,Usp__Msg * usp,combined_role_t * combined_role)
methods.description: Processes an Add request with 'allow_partial' set to false, aborting the entire process upon first failure to add an object.

methods.name: int ResolveObjectsToAdd(Usp__Add__CreateObject * cr,group_add_vector_t * gav,combined_role_t * combined_role,bool allow_partial)
methods.description: Resolves a path expression into specific objects to be created, handling permissions, wildcards, and errors.

methods.name: Usp__Msg * CreateFullAddResp(char * msg_id,group_add_vector_t * gav)
methods.description: Constructs a comprehensive AddResponse message based on the result of attempted object additions.

methods.name: Usp__Msg * CreateBasicAddResp(char * msg_id)
methods.description: Creates an initial empty AddResponse message template.

methods.name: Usp__AddResp__CreatedObjectResult__OperationStatus__OperationSuccess * AddResp_OperSuccess(Usp__AddResp * add_resp,char * req_path,char * path)
methods.description: Adds an operation success entry in the response, including path and optional details.

methods.name: Usp__AddResp__ParameterError * AddResp_OperSuccess_ParamErr(Usp__AddResp__CreatedObjectResult__OperationStatus__OperationSuccess * oper_success,char * path,int err_code,char * err_msg)
methods.description: Adds a parameter error to an operation success entry.

methods.name: void AddOperSuccess_UniqueKeys(Usp__AddResp__CreatedObjectResult__OperationStatus__OperationSuccess * oper_success,kv_vector_t * kvv)
methods.description: Associates unique key information with a successful add operation.

methods.name: Usp__AddResp__CreatedObjectResult__OperationStatus__OperationFailure * AddResp_OperFailure(Usp__AddResp * add_resp,char * path,int err_code,char * err_msg)
methods.description: Adds a failure entry to the response for an object that could not be created.

methods.name: Usp__Msg * CreateAddResponseError(char * msg_id,group_add_entry_t * gae)
methods.description: Creates an error response message when object creation fails due to specific reasons.

methods.name: bool AreAllPathsTheSameGroupId(Usp__Add * add)
methods.description: Checks if all object paths in an add request target the same data model group.

methods.name: int CalcGroupIdForPath(char * path_expr)
methods.description: Determines the group ID of a given path, used to ensure consistency across objects.
